items.title: Live: Socceroos make bright start against Paraguay after selection surprise
items.description: The Socceroos have made a stunning six changes to their starting line-up for the crucial clash with Paraguay. Follow live.

items.title: Stefanovic's move to outsider politics follows a well-worn lucrative path
items.description: Listening to the culture war showman schtick he has so quickly adopted, Karl Stefanovic is now less a newsman than an ideological performer.

items.title: Stefanovic thanks audience for 21 years on Today after 'tough' few days
items.description: Today show host Karl Stefanovic will leave Channel Nine after a controversial podcast interview with British far-right figure Tommy Robinson.

items.title: Live: Death toll rises to at least 235 as major rescue operation continues
items.description: More than 250 buildings are ruined or damaged after the devastating double quake, president of the National Asembly Jorge Rodríguez says. Follow live.

items.title: Comparing Trump's Iran negotiations to what Obama already did
items.description: The Trump administration has been negotiating directly with Iran this week in an effort to reach a long-term peace agreement, but it has several hurdles to clear before it can better the deal the United States already had.

items.title: UN pauses Strait of Hormuz evacuation after ship reports attack
items.description: The UN pauses its operation to escort ships through the Strait of Hormuz after a vessel reports an attack.

items.title: Live: PM flags strengthening powers of eSafety commissioner for social media ban
items.description: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese says the government will look to strengthen the powers of the eSafety commissioner to enforce an under-16s social media ban. Follow live.

items.title: 'An outright lie': Minister challenges Butler on Thriving Kids rollout
items.description: A member of the Thriving Kids advisory panel has voiced concern about how the support program for children with autism and developmental delay is being rolled out.

items.title: King Charles won't move into Buckingham palace, breaking royal tradition
items.description: An annual financial statement released on Thursday contained several revelations, including plans to cut the royal family's public funding, and details of how much tax the monarch paid.

items.title: Live: ASX opens higher as ACCC announces anti-price gouging law
items.description: The ASX opens higher in morning trading after mixed results on Wall Street. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

items.title: Breaking: Man who fatally shot officer Keith Smith sentenced to 40 years in jail
items.description: Tasmanian man Leigh Sushames shot dead Keith Smith last year when the police constable tried to serve him with a home repossession notice.

items.title: H5N1 emerged in Asia 30 years ago. Here's what happened next
items.description: Experts say Asia's decades-long experience fighting bird flu has shown there is no magic bullet and that fragmented responses to the disease will fail.

items.title: Warning fire ants could kill thousands of pets a year
items.description: If Australia does not ramp up fire ant eradication efforts, the invasive species will cause billion-dollar economic impacts and dozens of deaths, a study finds.

items.title: Daughter arrested after mother's body found at Sydney aged care home
items.description: Police question a 53-year-old woman in Sydney's west about an allegedly administered substance after her mother was found dead in an aged care home.

items.title: Supergirl shoots for the moon, but runs out of fuel
items.description: Australian Milly Alcock shines as Supergirl in the hero's first solo outing since 1984. If only the rest of the movie sparkled around her.

items.title: Friday news quiz: Neil the Seal, the teals party down and Trump drains his swamp
items.description: This week's news quiz features the usual assortment of political animals and regular animals, as well as other odd happenings from across the world.

items.title: Are these the 20 best albums of 2026 so far?
items.description: If you haven't had the time to keep up with new music this year, we've got you covered. Find your new favourite album here.

items.title: A failed forest utopia will watch nervously as the Socceroos play Paraguay
items.description: In rural Paraguay, a small farming town flies Australian flags. When Paraguay plays Australia at the 2026 World Cup today, its residents will be at the edge of their seats.

items.title: Man suing Spirit of Tasmania operator told he 'should have sat' on ship's toilet
items.description: A man who claims to have sustained injuries after falling over while using a toilet at sea says the ferry operator was negligent, the federal court has heard.

items.title: Police shoot and critically injure unarmed man charging at officers
items.description: A man has undergone emergency surgery after he was shot by police in Western Sydney.

items.title: SA Police officers 'did not act appropriately' in handling of DV survivor's case
items.description: South Australia Police has admitted that three officers did not "act appropriately" in how they handled the case of domestic violence victim Stella Magnisalis, who was assaulted multiple times by her then police detective husband.

items.title: Barring 'ISIS bride' could have triggered High Court challenge
items.description: Legal experts say the Commonwealth would have risked losing a High Court challenge to counterterrorism laws if it stopped the Australian woman from returning home.

items.title: Mixed reaction to beach town at forefront of over-50s lifestyle resort boom
items.description: Four over-50s lifestyle developments have been approved for this small beach community, with two more being assessed. Some worry the area is not ready for the influx, others say it is the answer to the housing crisis.

items.title: Terminally ill 72-year-old still chasing solo sailing dreams
items.description: David Burston had only just bought an old yacht to fix up and sail around Australia when he was diagnosed with stage 4 cancer. Hee has decided to keep pursuing his dream for as long as he can.

items.title: Dezi Freeman case leads to police gun carry changes
items.description: Chief Commissioner Mike Bush says Victoria Police officers in the state's alpine region will soon be permitted to carry long-arm rifles after the Dezi Freeman case.
